details:
On October 16, 2025 VRChat announced it had joined the Tech Coalition. An organization that aims to unite the global tech industry to protect children from online sexual abuse.

Under the Tech Coalition's membership criteria it lists a section labeled "Transparency" that states: "Members support transparency and accountability in the fight against OCSEA."

To date, VRChat has not released a single report in line with the coalition's membership criteria which would entail a "report that explain a company’s approach to addressing online child sexual exploitation and abuse (CSEA), which should highlight the company’s policies, explain its processes, and document the outcomes of its efforts."

For more on how Tech Coalition member transparency reports see https://technologycoalition.org/resources/trust-transparency-reporting-implementation-guide/

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
title: VRChat's Tech Coalition Child Safety Report is Overdue
